title: Allodium view definition
description: A single admin screen. The developer console writes these; the admin dashboard reads them. Everything derivable from the database — types, nullability, enum members, which table a foreign key points at — is read from the live catalog at render time and deliberately not repeated here.

$schema.description: Editor autocomplete only. Ignored at runtime.

title.description: Heading. Defaults to the table name, title-cased.

description.description: Shown under the heading — what this screen is for, in the operator's language.

primaryKey.description: Column that identifies a row. Defaults to the table's primary key, which is almost always right.

display.description: How a row of THIS table is labelled when something else references it. A column name, or a template: "{first_name} {last_name}". Defining it here means the table describes itself once, for every screen that points at it.

fields.description: Fields, in the order they should appear. Omit to expose every visible column.

field.description: A column, a foreign key, or a many-to-many.

columnField.title: column
columnField.description: A plain column on this view's own table.

column.description: Column name on this view's table.

widget.description: Input to render. Defaults from the SQL type: enum → select, boolean → checkbox, timestamptz → datetime, jsonb → json, text[] → tags, numeric/int → number, everything else → text.

options.description: For select/radio on a NON-enum column. Enum columns get their members from the database automatically — listing them here would be a second source of truth.

sortable.description: Whether the list may be sorted by this field. Defaults to true; only ever set false.

filterable.description: Whether the operator may filter on this field. Defaults to true; a filter on a false field is refused, not ignored.

relationField.title: relation (foreign key)
relationField.description: Which row of another table this one is attached to. The console fills `relation` in from the catalog's FK graph; the genuinely human decision is `display`.

column.description: The foreign-key column on this view's table.

value.description: Referenced column — the value actually stored. Defaults to that table's primary key.

display.description: Column or template shown to the operator, since the database stores an opaque id. Falls back to the target table's own `display`.

widget.description: select for many options, radio for a handful, autocomplete for very many.

sortable.description: Whether the list may be sorted by this field. Defaults to true; only ever set false.

filterable.description: Whether the operator may filter on this field. Defaults to true; a filter on a false field is refused, not ignored.

m2mField.title: many-to-many
m2mField.description: A many-to-many across a join table. A join table is a composite primary key whose columns are all foreign keys — NOT merely 'a table with two foreign keys'. Any other column on it is payload (granted_at, sort_order) and is not editable through this field.

name.description: Field name in the form's value object; it has no column of its own. Defaults to farTable.

near.description: Join-table column pointing back at this view's table.

far.description: Join-table column pointing at the other side.

farTable.description: The table on the other side.

farValue.description: Column `far` references. Defaults to farTable's primary key.

display.description: Column or template shown per option. Falls back to the far table's own `display`.

sortable.description: Whether the list may be sorted by this field. Defaults to true; only ever set false.

filterable.description: Whether the operator may filter on this field. Defaults to true; a filter on a false field is refused, not ignored.

columns.description: Columns shown in the table, in order. Defaults to the first few fields.

searchColumns.description: Columns a search box should match against (ILIKE).

filter.description: Rows this screen may show at all. A baseline the operator cannot clear — not a security boundary.

label.description: Human label. Defaults to the column name, title-cased.

help.description: Help text under the input. Omit to inherit the column's Postgres COMMENT, so a description written once in the schema reaches every screen without being restated.

required.description: Override the schema's nullability. Defaults to NOT NULL ⇒ required.

in.description: Where this field appears. Defaults to both.

column.description: A field key on the view (or a column, on a relation target).

op.description: Defaults to in for an array value, isNull for null, eq otherwise.

filter.description: Predicates, ANDed. Either the explicit array or the equality shorthand { column: value }.
